headline: Battle Lines Stir Across Contested Frontier
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Callahan’s Passage has become the clearest flare point, with eight base events in two hours and 21 in the day; its ten holdings remain nine Warden and one Colonial. Weathered Expanse is still unsettled, though its immediate pace has eased to two events in two hours and nine in six, amid seven Colonial bases and two neutral ground. Stlican Shelf records three events in the latest two hours and 16 across 24, with seven Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral holding. Nevish Line has resumed movement after a quieter immediate spell, showing one event in two hours and 50 in the day across five Warden and three Colonial bases. Stonecradle’s action has cooled at the latest count—no event in two hours, but five in six and ten in 24—with seven Colonial and two Warden bases. Mooring County has no fresh base event in two hours, yet its casualty rates are accelerating on both sides and three events remain logged for the day. Most other fronts are quiet or firmly held; victory remains undecided.
